How do I create a sales questionnaire template?

plan.angle: The top 10 is static pre-sales and seller questionnaire templates (form-builder template galleries, a printable seller form, county sales verification sheets): each gives a list of questions and stops there. This page treats the sales questionnaire template as a working qualification app: questions that branch by deal type, answers that send big prospects to an account executive, seller details in an agent's inbox before the listing appointment, and lost-deal reasons counted on a dashboard.
tab_stories: Orvanta sells shift scheduling software; a home care agency with 140 caregivers answers the pre-demo questionnaire, and because it has 50 or more staff the app messages account executive Feodora Halcott in Slack.

Saltreed Studio, a web design shop, asks first whether a prospect wants a new site or a redesign; a redesign answer opens questions about the current site, and the founder reads the record before the discovery call.

Mirovale Realty sends its seller questionnaire before each listing appointment; a seller on Neddick Lane reports a 2021 roof and a June 30 move date, and agent Pradeep Lumsley gets the answers by email.

Caddenby, an inventory software company, sends a 4-question questionnaire to every buyer who chose another vendor; 23 replies last quarter, 9 of them naming price, are counted on a dashboard and saved to each deal in HubSpot.
